answer_2.quote: Our metric is accuracy, which is the proportion of pairs, (consisting an observed CS sentence s o and a manipulated variant s m , from the challenge set of a  language pair, S), for which the LLM, M, assigns higher probability to the observed CS sentence

answer_4.quote: We needed bilingual or near-bilingual participants who were likely to employ CS in their own daily lives. We therefore recruited individuals whose mother tongue is not English and who have lived in the US or UK for at least one year at one point in their lives.
answer_4.guideline: We told annotators to select from a sentence pair the one that had been produced by another bilingual. We also told them that the other sentence had been altered.
